title: How Often an Enrolment Has Been Reported On and the Share of the Ceiling a Claim Opens At
content:
The number of damage reports standing on a Keyturn Host Protection Plan enrolment in the period its reporting record is read over settles how much of the ceiling for the kind of loss the claim is opened at.

- Where four or more damage reports stand on the enrolment in the period the reporting record is read over, the ceiling for the kind of loss is taken at half.
- Where two or three reports stand in that period, it is taken at three quarters.
- Where fewer than two reports stand in that period, it is taken in full.

### Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical figures)

| Reports standing in the period | Share of the ceiling | A ceiling of 26000 opens at |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | half | 13000 |
| 4 | half | 13000 |
| 3 | three quarters | 19500 |
| 2 | three quarters | 19500 |
| 1 | the whole | 26000 |
| 0 | the whole | 26000 |

Four reports is the threshold for the half: three reports leaves the claim on three quarters, and one report leaves it on the whole of the ceiling.

### Where the facts come from

The reports counted are those lodged on the damage report register against this enrolment, taken over the period that enrolment's reporting record is read over.
